title: Smoky Barbecue Beans and Rice
subtitle: with Easy Guacamole
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Check your avocado is ripe before starting this recipe (see Cooking tip). Finely chop the onion. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the beans. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.

Cook rice: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook 2 tsp barbecue seasoning, stirring, for 30 secs. Stir in the rice. Add 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Season with salt and pepper.

Saute veggies: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the capsicum, garlic and half the onion (see Make it yours), stirring, for 5 mins or until softened. Add the remaining barbecue seasoning and 1 tbs tomato sauce and cook, stirring, for 30 secs.

Simmer beans: Add the beans, tomatoes and 60ml (¼ cup) water to the veggies and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring, for 10 mins or until slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Coarsely mash the avocado in a bowl. Add the remaining onion and 1 tsp red wine vinegar, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Divide the rice and beans among bowls, top with the guacamole and enjoy!
Make it yours: If you don't like the taste of raw onion, cook all the onion and leave it out of the guacamole.
